title: 때문에 por causa de
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL guide compares **-기 때문에** with **-(으)므로**: both give a reason or basis, but they differ in register and in whether a following command or proposal is licensed. This entry is limited to those documented differences and does not repeat the separate noun + 때문에 lesson.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). *한국어교육 문법·표현 내용 개발 연구(3단계) [Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3)]*. https://www.korean.go.kr/common/download.do;front=B5CD4F10151810563982D51A3FD4329B?c_file_name=5a2db2bc-a7ad-49f4-84a4-34b20ad33ffc_0.pdf&file_path=reportData&o_file_name=%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%96%B4%EA%B5%90%EC%9C%A1+%EB%AC%B8%EB%B2%95%ED%91%9C%ED%98%84+%EB%82%B4%EC%9A%A9%EA%B0%9C%EB%B0%9C+%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC_3%EB%8B%A8%EA%B3%84.pdf

Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3), PDF pp. 140–141, 266–268 (printed pp. 141, 267–269): comparison table for -기 때문에 and -(으)므로, including clause-type restrictions.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **-기 때문에**, **덕분에**, **그래서**, **왜냐하면** y **-아/어서**. Todas expresan relaciones de causa o explicación, pero difieren en estructura, matiz y organización del discurso.
